WHAT IS AREA?
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what what is area? means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Area.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
A learner studying MATHEMATICS meets what is area? first by naming the idea, then by using one Kenyan example from a classroom in Kisumu. In plain words: identify the relationship between square metre (m2 ) and hectares as units of measuring area. One useful fact to keep: E) recognize the use of area.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Measurement problems need a formula, correct units, and careful substitution.
• Perimeter is the distance around a shape. Area is the surface covered. Volume/capacity is space inside.
• Example lengths for this page: 7 cm and 5 cm.
• Write units in the final answer (cm, m, cm², m², litres).
• Sketch the figure and label sides before calculating.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a classroom in Kisumu:
A square garden has side 7 m. Find the area.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 7 × 7
3. Area = 49
Final Answer: 49 m²
